record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a deterministic prefix-length feature by multiplying each history embedding by 1+0.1*(1-exp(-k/8)), where k counts observed nonpadding interactions through that position within the retained history. This mildly distinguishes short-context inputs from established histories without relying on nonexistent repeats. Use identical causal computation during training and prediction; keep padding zero, candidate embeddings unchanged, and preserve learned embedding design, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer.

category_rationales.rationale: Test whether a mild causal prefix-length feature distinguishes short histories from established contexts across all four datasets. Scale only history inputs by 1+0.1*(1-exp(-k/8)), preserving padding zeros, candidate embeddings, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the same model implementation and validates feature metadata.
